visa.type.text: buy it online in advance or at the airport on arrival

visa.activities_allowed.text: selling goods or services, or being paid by anyone in Indonesia

visa.max_stay_days.text: 30 days, extendable once for another 30 days

documents.passport_validity.text: 6 months beyond your arrival date and have 2 blank pages

visa.tourist_levy_exemptions.text: holders of diplomatic and official visas, transport crew, holders of Indonesian stay permits, and holders of family unification, student and golden visas

visa.tourist_levy_enforcement.text: being refused service at tourist attractions

safety_health.drug_laws.text: some prescription medications, including those for ADHD, are illegal in Indonesia

customs.tobacco_allowance.text: 200 cigarettes, or 25 cigars, or 100 grams of tobacco

customs.vape_allowance.text: 30 ml of open-system liquid, or 12 ml of closed-system liquid

customs.excess_destroyed.text: destroyed on the spot by the customs officer

getting_around.driving_permit.text: a US driver's license alone is not recognized in Indonesia

getting_around.licence_must_match_vehicl.text: a license matching the type of vehicle driven

getting_around.traffic_penalties.text: 4 months' detention or a fine of IDR 1,000,000 for riding without the required license
